TitleBar Navigation Bar

Currently, only manual import is supported, and the npm function is still in incubation.

"usingComponents": {
  "maui-title-bar": "../../components/title-bar/index"
}

Sample Code

Basic Usage

<maui-title-bar bind:clickLeft="onClickLeft" bind:clickRight="onClickRight" left-arrow title="Malce" right-text="Button" left-text="Back" rightStyle="color:purple;" leftStyle="color:red" titleStyle="color:orange" />

Page({
onClickLeft() {
console.log("left")
},
onClickRight() {
console.log("right")
}
});

Advanced Usage

Customize the left icon and use slot for the right side

<maui-title-bar  use-slot  left-arrow left-icon="reduce" title="Malce"  >
<maui-icon name="reduce"></maui-icon>
</maui-title-bar>

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
title Title String -
title-style Title style String -
left-text Left text String -
left-style Left style String -
right-text Right text String -
right-style Right style String -
left-arrow Whether to display the left icon Boolean false
left-icon Custom left icon, effective when left-arrow is true / fixed value String arrowleft
left-image Custom left icon, effective when left-arrow is false / image src String -
fixed Whether to fix at the top Boolean false
safe-area-inset-top Whether to leave a safe distance at the top (status bar height) Boolean true
z-index Element z-index Number 1
use-slot Whether to use slot, effective when right-text does not exist Boolean false

Left-icon Value Types

Add arrowleft for left arrow

Events

Event Name Description
bind:clickLeft Triggered when clicking the left button
bind:clickRight Triggered when clicking the right button
